source: VIBE_IC_PPA_ENHANCEMENT_SPEC_v1.2_FINAL Appendix C, sections C.1 and C.2. English rendering frozen by the orchestrator 2026-08-21 so that all PPA lanes share one wording.
merge_condition: Every applicable question has verifiable evidence, and every inapplicable question has a machine-checkable reason.
note_numbering: C.1 numbering is deliberately NON-CONTIGUOUS: 6, 7, 11, 12, 16, 18, 19 and 20 live in C.2. That is the spec's numbering. It is not a gap introduced here and must not be closed up.
note_c1_release_clause: C.1 reads: 'For a PR that touches neither AI nor closure, questions 8-10, 13-15 and 17 may be marked N/A.' The permission is JOINT, not per-question: it is granted only when NEITHER an AI surface NOR a closure surface is touched. So all seven carry the same release condition (any of ai / agent / closure present -> all seven apply). This is the literal contract text; a per-question reading would be an invention.
note_min_evidence_kinds: Where a question's own text names the artefact type it is asking about, that kind is required. Question 3 asks for a source artifact and its hash -> an 'artefact' entry. Questions 4, 5, 11 and 19 each ask what happens when something is EXERCISED ('what does it emit', 'can rc=2 be misread', 'can a negative fixture turn this red', 'was it tested against') -> a named 'test'. Every other question accepts any verifiable kind. Nothing here was invented beyond what the question sentence itself names.

evidence_kinds.artefact: A repo-relative path plus a declared sha256. VERIFIED only when the file exists and the declared digest equals the computed one.
evidence_kinds.test: A test id of the form <repo-relative file>::<test name>. VERIFIED only when the file exists and it defines that test.
evidence_kinds.path: A repo-relative path that must exist. VERIFIED by existence; its sha256 is recorded so the answer is re-checkable later.
evidence_kinds.prose: Free text. NEVER verifiable, by design. It may accompany an answer; it can never satisfy one. This is what makes the merge condition 'verifiable evidence' rather than 'twenty long answers'.

questions.text: Does this program measure a requirement, a metric, a proxy, or feasibility?
Which implementation, stage, mode, corner and activity basis does the number belong to?
Where is the source artifact, and its hash?
What does it emit when nothing was measured?
Can rc=2 be misread as PASS?
Could a candidate win by modifying the problem itself?
Could an infeasible candidate enter the frontier?
Does this closed loop actually have an actuator?
Which domains were re-measured after the actuator ran?
How is a regression rolled back?
Can a negative fixture turn this gate red?
Does an outward claim's scope exceed its evidence?
Was the program genuinely unable to decide, before handing off to AI?
Which exact evidence does the AI proposal cite?
Is the action inside the typed registry, the budget, the blast radius and the autonomy level?
Does the program-only path still hold when AI is unavailable?
When the program and the AI disagree, who stops the promotion?
Can this AI recovery be distilled into a program / gate / fixture?
Was it tested against prompt injection, hallucinated metric, generic MCP bypass, raw script, metacharacter, path/symlink traversal and arbitrary shell?
Has the AI-attributed improvement been separated from simply spending more compute or more trials?
